messages:
Maya R.: quick summary — ran multi-quant concordance suite for the new FP8 kernel on H100 and L40S. low-level findings + rollout proposal below. :eyes:
Samir: awesome, paste the numbers?
Maya R.: short table (high level):
```
model: orion-13b
configs: FP32 baseline | FP8-kernel (hetero) | AWQ-INT4 | GPTQ-INT4
H100 latency p50: 42ms | 38ms | 45ms | 44ms
L40S latency p50: 55ms | 48ms | 52ms | 50ms
MMLU delta vs FP32: 0.0% | -0.9% | -1.8% | -1.5%
long-prefix failure rate (>2k tokens): 0.2% | 1.9% | 0.6% | 0.7%
```
Maya R.: notable: FP8 gives best latency but a small accuracy hit on some long-context prompts and manifests as prefix "silent drift" on a small subset of evals.
Hailey: when you say "silent drift" do you mean output distribution shift or NAN-esque artifacts?
Maya R.: distribution shift; tokens are still valid, just more repetitive/confident on certain adversarial prefix patterns. no NaNs.
Devon: any pattern on kv-cache/chunking? L40S often has different tiling behavior.
Maya R.: yes — on L40S we saw more pronounced drift when sequence length transitions cause runqueue retiling. repro steps: warm cache with 1.2k prefix, then feed a 600-token continuation with many rare tokens. FP8 path hits a different kernel path when tiling flips.
Samir: can you drop the short log excerpt?
Maya R.:
```
[2026-02-12T14:03:12Z] serving: start gen seq=1200 config=fp8
[2026-02-12T14:03:12Z] runtime: select kernel=hetero_fp8_tiling_v2
[2026-02-12T14:03:16Z] warning: activation-sat > 0.92 layer=23
[2026-02-12T14:03:16Z] result: repetition_score +12% vs baseline
```
Hailey: interesting. activation saturation could explain quantization clip effects. did you try per-channel rescale or act-scaling?
Maya R.: yup — per-channel act rescale reduces the MMLU delta from -0.9% to -0.4% and reduces repetition_score by ~60% in the failing set. but it costs ~1.5ms p50 on H100.
Devon: tradeoffs. For rollout we need a safe policy that avoids exposing long-prefix customers.
Samir: what about a mixed deployment policy: FP8 for short contexts and AWQ/GPTQ for long-prefix routes?
Maya R.: propose:
- canary FP8 on H100 only @ 5% traffic, exclude routes with max_context > 1024
- enable per-channel act-rescale by default in FP8 runtime (opt-in flag to disable)
- L40S: hold FP8 until tiling swap heuristics are hardened (need a fix in runtime to keep kernel stable across tiling boundaries)
- telemetry: add a "fp8-prefix-drift" regression alert tied to evaluation prompt set and repetition_score > 10%
Samir: sounds sensible. timeline?
Maya R.: canary config ready, just need infra approval for H100 pool mapping. perf-bot ran the smoke bench; gist:
```
perf-bot: fp8-canary-smoke: p50 38ms (-10% vs baseline), p95 72ms (-8%); mem overhead +1.6%
```
canary-bot: canary created: fp8-h100-5pc-excl-longctx, started 2026-02-13 09:00UTC
Hailey: I'll own the act-rescale flag test matrix and validation prompts. Samir can you handle the rollout playbook + rollback triggers?
Samir: yeah I'll draft playbook. rollback triggers: MMLU regression > 0.5% over last 4h OR fp8-prefix-drift alert firing twice in 1h.
Devon: add a per-model opt-out list for enterprise customers.
Maya R.: noted. next steps: Hailey to run act-rescale ablation across 10 models, Samir to author playbook, infra to approve H100 mapping. I'll start the canary tomorrow and share dashboards.
Hailey: quick note — plan to include AWQ/GPTQ comparisons in the same dashboard to help SRE decide fallback routing automatically.
Samir: ok locking in. thanks all :thumbsup:
Maya R.: thanks — filing followups in tracker (onboard-quant-1745).
